import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(['python', '-m', 'pytest', 'test_semver.py', '-v', '--tb=short'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout[-10000:])  # Last 10000 chars of output
if result.returncode != 0:
    # Print errors
    lines = result.stdout.split('\n')
    error_lines = [l for l in lines if 'FAILED' in l or 'ERROR' in l]
    print("\n\nFailed tests:")
    for l in error_lines[:30]:
        print(l)
